entities.title: Worker
entities.summary: The Cloudflare Worker: serves the built game to invited players, and keeps nothing.
entities.purpose: Stands in front of every file of the game: checks icelander.net's sign-in and the invite-only role games:lundey, then hands the request to Cloudflare's static assets and marks the answer private.
boundaries: No database, no Durable Object, no secrets and no API: it answers GET and HEAD for the game's files and nothing else. The game itself runs in the browser.

The sign-in is checked with vendor/icelander-auth, which is icelander.net's and never edited here. The sign-in pages themselves (/auth/…) are not this Worker's: its route covers only icelander.net/games/lundey*.
config.ts holds the address and the role in a module of their own, because a Worker's main module may export nothing but its handler.
